scripts.build: cargo fetch --quiet --locked --manifest-path crate/Cargo.toml && wasm-pack --quiet build crate --target web --release --out-dir ../pkg --no-pack --no-opt --mode no-install -- --locked
scripts.test: pnpm run build && cargo test --quiet --locked --manifest-path crate/Cargo.toml && vitest run
scripts.lint: cargo fmt --check --manifest-path crate/Cargo.toml && cargo clippy --quiet --locked --manifest-path crate/Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo clippy --quiet --locked --manifest-path crate/Cargo.toml --target wasm32-unknown-unknown -- -D warnings
